spec.description: PS2Alerts: API traffic and visitors, alert liveness, RabbitMQ, Mongo, host and container health, and the aggregators.

spec.title: Requests / s
spec.description: Every API request that reached the origin, excluding /metrics and /healthcheck.

spec.title: Clients (5 min)
spec.description: Distinct client IPs seen in the last five minutes. Cloudflare's CF-Connecting-IP, so a NAT counts once.

spec.title: Server errors / s
spec.description: 5xx responses. Expect zero.

spec.title: Bandwidth out
spec.description: Response bytes before compression, so an upper bound on what crossed the tunnel.

spec.title: Requests by endpoint
spec.description: Top 12 route patterns by request rate.

spec.title: p95 response time by endpoint
spec.description: The 8 slowest route patterns. Lines, not stacked: adding percentiles together would show latencies no request had.

spec.title: Bandwidth by endpoint
spec.description: Which routes send the most data.

spec.title: Heaviest clients (last 5 min)
spec.description: The ten busiest clients right now. This is what the heavy-client alert reads.

spec.title: Busiest client, busiest minute
spec.description: The most requests any single client made in one 60-second span, looking back five minutes. The heavy-client alert fires above 200.

spec.title: Active users
spec.description: Distinct clients polling /instances/active in the last five minutes: anyone with the site open.

spec.title: Alerts running
spec.description: Metagame alerts in progress according to the database.

spec.title: Hours since last alert
spec.description: Since the newest recorded alert started. The host healthcheck pages at 12h.

spec.title: Liveness data age
spec.description: Minutes since the two alert gauges beside this last refreshed. They refresh every 5 minutes; anything older means the Mongo query is failing and those figures are stale.

spec.title: Most viewed alerts (5 min)
spec.description: Distinct viewers per alert across its page and aggregate endpoints. The alert ID sits in exported_instance because Prometheus reserves instance for the scrape target.

spec.title: Alerts tracked by aggregators
spec.description: The aggregators' own view of alert instances, by platform.

spec.title: Messages waiting
spec.description: Every queued message across RabbitMQ.

spec.title: Delay queues
spec.description: Alert results held until the 46- and 91-minute timers fire, then dead-lettered onto api-queue-production. A large 91-minute backlog is normal.

spec.title: API queue
spec.description: api-queue-production, drained by api-aggregator. Ready should stay near zero.

spec.title: Aggregator queues
spec.description: Messages waiting in the aggregators' queues: the per-world MetagameEvent queues and each running alert's event queues.

spec.title: Broker throughput
spec.description: Messages entering, delivered and acknowledged per second.

spec.title: Queues without consumers
spec.description: Queues holding messages with nobody reading them, excluding the delay queues, which never have consumers.

spec.title: RabbitMQ memory
spec.description: Resident memory against the high watermark, above which RabbitMQ blocks publishers.

spec.title: Messages received by type
spec.description: Census events published into the aggregators' queues per second, stacked by type with the largest on top. Per-alert queues only exist while an alert runs.

spec.title: Messages processed by type
spec.description: What the aggregators successfully processed per second across all platforms, stacked by type with the largest on top.

spec.title: Mongo latency by op type
spec.description: Average per operation.

spec.title: Busiest collections
spec.description: Time Mongo spent per collection, per second.

spec.title: WiredTiger cache used
spec.description: Cache fill against its configured maximum.

spec.title: Aggregator Redis keys
spec.description: Cached entities held by the aggregators.

spec.title: Host CPU
spec.description: By mode, across both cores.

spec.title: IO pressure
spec.description: Share of time some task was stalled on IO (PSI). The backup stalls show here.

spec.title: Memory by container
spec.description: Working set.

spec.title: Disk writes by container
spec.description: What the hourly backups pay for.

spec.title: Scrape targets up
spec.description: Every PS2Alerts endpoint Prometheus reads. Anything below 1 is down or refusing the scrape.

spec.title: Messages by world
spec.description: Census events processed per world.

spec.title: External requests
spec.description: Census and PS2Alerts API calls made by the aggregators.

spec.title: Unknown facilities / items
spec.description: Census IDs the aggregators could not resolve.

spec.title: PS2Alerts
